name: Camp Androscoggin
description_short: Overnight camp for boys on Lake Androscoggin in Wayne, Maine, founded in 1907. For 2027 it offers a seven-week full session or a four-week session at the start of the summer, with all-inclusive tuition.

warnings: Only the Dates & Rates page was read, so the program, location and age details are missing.
The four-week session is only available at the start of the summer. Campers in it can extend to the full season.
Visiting days (July 23 and 24) are listed for both sessions. Rookie Days (Thursday, July 22 and Saturday, July 31, 9:45-1:30) are tour/trial days for prospective campers, not bookable sessions.
The page says 'Fully Accredited' but does not name the accrediting body, so aca_accredited is left null.
